instructions: In a large baking dish, whisk together the onion, garlic, olive oil, chicken consommé, honey, soy sauce, paprika, black pepper, garlic powder, and water.
Stir in the dry orzo, distributing it evenly.
Season the chicken thighs lightly with salt and pepper; nestle them skin-side up into the orzo.
Cover tightly with foil and bake for 40 minutes.
Uncover, spoon the sauce over the chicken, and bake 15–20 minutes more, until the chicken is glossy and tender.
Optional: broil 2–3 minutes for extra color. Rest 5 minutes before serving.
notes: Meat dish (chicken thighs, chicken consommé). One-pan dinner: the orzo cooks in the baking dish with the chicken — no draining, no stirring, no second pan. Submitted as an Instagram screenshot (2026-10-20). Black pepper appears in the directions (whisked into the sauce and used to season the chicken) but with no quantity, so it's listed as optional to taste.

tips.text: After uncovering, spoon the pan sauce over the chicken before the final bake — that's what lacquers the skin, not the broiler.
tips.title: The gloss comes from basting

tips.text: The source promises the dish tastes better the next day. Store covered in the fridge and reheat gently.
tips.title: Even better tomorrow

title: Honey Garlic Chicken & Orzo
